title: Controlled Ledyba chain retry and reposition

verification.actor: WILD species 165 (ledyba), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: After natural spawn and normal eligible commits, reject exactly one naturally selected action-5 start before motion work; observe pending-state restoration and retry.
verification.observable: Same live Wild Ledyba, unchanged selected action/ticks and commit count, one full cooldown frame, then four complete profile-derived reposition legs with native boundaries and terminal control.

setupMutations.change: Return PROFILE once at the authenticated prepared-jump entry for the bound naturally selected action5. No guest RAM, RNG, cooldown, chain counter or position writes.

limits: Controlled retry only; normal Ledyba timing has its separate accepted witness.
The obsolete forced nine-Walk/fixed-frame fixture is archived at documentation/overworld-system/archive/chain-retry-legacy-measurements.json; current expectation comes from the authenticated profile.
Copied-data controls test the evaluator; separate live reader calibration remains required.

events.value: Acquire natural Wild Ledyba at its own spawn site and observe its completed spawn Hop.
Bind the exact subject after normal eligible movement; arm one typed rejection.
Verify selected action/ticks and commit count survive the rejected start and full cooldown frame.
Observe all four profile-derived reposition motions and terminal control.

stop.condition: The one retried profile-defined action completes and control returns

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
